latest.title: Exterior Serrin Rigidity for the Homogeneous{k}-Hessian Equation
latest.abstract: In this paper, we study the exterior overdetermined problems for the homogeneous k-Hessian equations $$σ_k(D^2u)=0\quad\text{in}~\mathbb{R}^n\setminus\overlineΩ$$ in three dimensional regimes. For $2\le k<n$ and smooth strictly star-shaped domain $Ω\Subset\R^n$, we establish ball rigidity results in all three dimensional regimes. If $2\leq k<\frac{n}{2}$, the solution with boundary value $-1$ and limit zero at infinity is treated under strict $(k-1)$-convexity of $\partialΩ$. If $k=\frac{n}{2}$, the solution with boundary value $0$ and logarithmic growth at infinity is considered under strict $(k-1)$-convexity of $\partialΩ$; if $k>\frac{n}{2}$, the solution with boundary $1$ and fundamental power-growth at infinity is considered under strict $(k-1)$-convexity of $\partialΩ$. In each case, for a positive constant $c$, $|Du|=c>0$ on $\partialΩ$ forces $Ω$ to be a Euclidean ball and determines the solution explicitly. The three arguments are organized by the single parameter $q=(n-k)/k$ and the scale function \[ F_q(t)=\frac{t^{1-q}-1}{1-q},\qquad F_1(t)=\log t. \] After normalization, $U=F_q(v)$ and $M_q[v]=vD^2v-qDv\otimes Dv$ satisfies $σ_k(M_q[v])=0$. A unified contact-point calculation gives the sharp bound $|Dv|\le b$;a boundary viscosity contact then yields $H_k\ge qbH_{k-1}$. The integral mechanism that closes the argument changes at the critical exponent: Rellich--Pohozaev identities are used for $q>1$, a scale-invariant Wronskian--Newton current for $q=1$, and a renormalized Newton--Jacobi mass for $q<1$. When $q\leq 1,$ we also obtain a global strict k-convex defining function by Minkowski gauge, this help us extend the exterior construction from convex domains to strictly star-shaped domains.
latest.workSummary: 研究外部 Serrin 条件下齐次 k-Hessian 方程的刚性：先完成 rank-one Hessian 补全和有限部渐近，再建立外部梯度最大值与边界曲率不等式，最后用 Rellich--Pohozaev 通量恒等式得到边界比值和球形结论。
latest.breakthrough: 将外部衰减解的无穷远质量与有限部严格对应起来，并把 Serrin 边界条件转为边界商恒等式，在次临界、临界和超临界区间统一排除非球形外域。
latest.limitations: 域需光滑、有界、严格星形及严格(k-1)-凸，且 k 分区间决定不同的无穷远处理；结论不覆盖一般非星形外域。

steps.claim: 外部解的 Hessian/梯度可在无穷远具有可控的有限部展开。
steps.route: 以径向模型和 rank-one Hessian completion 处理主导特征值，建立外部解的渐近展开、Newton 张量弱连续性及有限部质量定义。
steps.evidence: 第 2 节 Lemma 2.1、Propositions 2.2--2.5（PDF 第 6--13 页）。

steps.claim: Serrin 边界条件迫使外部梯度最大值出现在边界并产生曲率约束。
steps.route: 对梯度的 gauge 函数使用最大值原理，结合 Newton 张量的边界收缩建立 boundary curvature inequality，再将恒定法向导数写成边界商。
steps.evidence: 第 3 节 Lemma 3.1、Proposition 3.2、Proposition 3.3（PDF 第 14--17 页）。

steps.claim: 外部区域的通量守恒把边界积分与无穷远有限部联系起来。
steps.route: 对 Newton 张量构造的 current 做截断外域积分，应用 divergence theorem；令外半径趋于无穷，vanishing Wronskian flux 消去余项，得到 Rellich--Pohozaev 型恒等式。
steps.evidence: 第 4--5 节 Lemmas 4.1--4.2、Lemma 5.2（PDF 第 18--25 页）。

steps.claim: 不同 k 区间的边界比值恒等式与严格凸性共同推出外域刚性。
steps.route: 将有限部质量代回 subcritical/critical/supercritical boundary ratio，结合 boundary curvature inequality；等号情形强迫支持函数和曲率常数化，从而域为球并完成 Theorems 1.5--1.7。
steps.evidence: 第 1 节 Theorems 1.5--1.7（PDF 第 4--5 页）及 Propositions 4.3、5.3、6.5（PDF 第 22--33 页）。

latest.aiEvidenceSource: 已检查 PDF 第 1--33 页关键词 AI、artificial intelligence、LLM、ChatGPT、GPT、Claude、language model，并检查致谢。
latest.priorityReason: 同时涉及完全非线性椭圆方程、过定边界数据、临界尺度和域刚性，统一参数化与多种积分机制具有较强结构价值。
